defect: external AXI-stream input timing contract is unstated
rationale: The RTL is a valid single-clock stream register, but no board or upstream-clock contract gives the launch phase and min/max delay of the AXI inputs; the numeric input-delay values therefore cannot be judged from this case.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the AXI register to one 32-bit elastic stage while leaving the external timing contract unspecified.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Single clock, all synchronous ports have input/output delays; feedthrough tready path fits the period.
The SDC supplies numeric delays but no upstream launch or board contract. Completeness of command coverage does not establish that those values describe the environment.
